verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU,totegeerekeka,
Ogulumizibwa,
Ekitiibwa ky'amaaso go,
Kibuna-ensi zonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Okukulaba n'amaaso,
Kusinga-eby'omu nsi,
-Amagezi go n'ekisa kyo,
Tebikomezrka.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Katonda wange nga nkutya
Nga neewombeese nnyo:
Era nkusinza n'omwoyo,
Nga neetereereka.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Amaanyi go n'ekisa kyo,
Byombi bya tttendo nnyo:
Naye weefeebya-okunsaba
Okwagalanga ggwe.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Bw'olidda ggwe mu nsi muno
-Okusinzibwa bonna
Naakwebzanga-ekisa kyo
Emirembe gyonna.
